marbre-blanc-carrare.description: Carrara white marble is synonymous with pure elegance. Its delicate grey veins create a subtle contrast perfect for luxurious kitchens and bathrooms.

marbre-noir-marquina.description: Deep black with striking white veins, this Spanish marble brings a dramatic, sophisticated touch to any modern space.

travertin-beige.description: Beige travertine offers mineral warmth and authentic texture, ideal for Mediterranean interiors and elegant flooring.

granit-rouge-imperial.description: Imperial red granite with deep reflections, perfect for bold countertops and standout architectural details.

marbre-emeraude.description: A rare marble with deep green tones and white veins, ideal for bold, natural focal points.

onyx-honey.description: Translucent honey onyx with golden veins, chosen for backlit features and surfaces that capture the light.

meta.title: About Us | MARBRERIE TUNIS CARTHAGE — Craftsmanship & Excellence
meta.description: Discover the heritage, core values, and certifications of MARBRERIE TUNIS CARTHAGE. The art of natural stone since 1989.

intro.title: A story of passion and craftsmanship
intro.paragraph1: For over three decades, MARBRERIE TUNIS CARTHAGE has elevated the finest natural stones of Tunisia and the Mediterranean basin. From quarry selection to meticulous workshop polishing, each creation embodies a timeless balance between artisanal heritage and state-of-the-art technology.
intro.paragraph2: We partner with architects, interior designers, and discerning private clients to bring ambitious projects to life, sculpting marble, granite, and travertine with goldsmith precision.

coordonnees.title: Bring your exceptional projects to life
coordonnees.description: Our advisors and master stonecutters are available to review your architectural plans, present material samples, and guide you through every stage of execution.
